Sam: Heads-up — Prospect (large finserv) asked for SSO/SAML + MFA + RBAC artifacts for their vendor risk review. They want the SIG/CAIQ answers, IdP metadata, and a role-mapping example.
Priya: Ok — do they need SCIM provisioning details too? Also ask whether they require audit/log exports (syslog/S3) and retention window.
Sam: They listed: SAML metadata (IdP/SP), MFA enforcement proof, RBAC role matrix, and a short writeup on least-privilege defaults. SCIM was optional.
Alex: I can bundle sample JSON for role mappings and a scrubbable screenshot of the Console > Teams > Roles page. I also have a template SCIM mapping for Okta.
Maya: I'll propose a POC timeline: 1) deliver artifacts within 48h, 2) 2-week POC with a sandbox tenant, 3) joint runbook session. Sound ok?
Priya: For MFA proof we typically provide: (a) policy screenshots showing "MFA required for all users", (b) a short blurb: "We enforce MFA at SSO gateway; tokens not accepted without 2FA", and (c) logs showing last 30 days of auth events (redacted).
Priya: Note: we can't share customer data; logs must be filtered. I can produce a synthetic sample log with the same schema.
Sam: Customer also asked if we support IdP-initiated logout and SAML 2.0 attributes mapping.
Alex: Yes — SAML 2.0 supported. Example SP metadata attached in this thread (I will paste the snippet). Use this config in Okta/ADFS:

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://api.redwood.example">
  <!-- simplified SP metadata -->
  <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.example/saml/acs"/>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Alex: We'll also include SCIM endpoint info: POST /scim/v2/Users, bearer token auth, and sample payload.
Sam: Great — can Priya confirm if we have a pre-made SIG-lite (partial CAIQ) we can send? They often prefer a filled CAIQ spreadsheet.
Priya: We maintain a prefilled CAIQ/ SIG profile for Hosted API + Dedicated. I’ll export the current sheet and mark items that require customer confirmation (e.g., firewall rules for Private deployments).
Maya: I'll draft the email to the prospect: attach the CAIQ, SP metadata, role matrix, mock logs, SCIM doc, and propose POC kickoff Wed AM. Can someone review the draft?
Alex: I’ll review the role mapping + SCIM snippets. Priya — please review the CAIQ redactions.
Priya: Will do. Also flag: if they ask about service accounts and least privilege for machine tokens, provide our recommended policy (rotate keys monthly, scoped token roles: read-only vs inference-runner).
Sam: They asked about MFA for service accounts (machine-to-machine). We should state we do not enforce interactive MFA on machine tokens; instead we recommend short-lived credentials + rotation & scoped tokens.
deploy-bot: Reminder: security docs repo updated at 2025-11-12T09:12:03Z — /internal/security/iam/. See changelog.
Maya: Perfect — timeline: draft + attachments by EOD today, Priya/Alex review by 10:30 tomorrow, send to prospect at 11:00. Sam will own follow-ups in the thread.
Sam: Thanks everyone — I’ll upload the draft and tag you both. :thumbsup:
thread_text_excerpt: Prospect requests SSO/SAML, MFA, RBAC artifacts + CAIQ for vendor review; coordinate POC and artifact delivery
